Scenario fixture: a11ycore-empty-heading

Each target has a stable id of the form eh_case_NN.

01 — NEUTRAL: heading with text content

Section title

02 — CANTTELL: empty heading, no accessible name

03 — NEUTRAL: empty native heading but has aria-label

04 — NEUTRAL: empty heading but has a title attribute (last-resort naming fallback)

05 — NEUTRAL: empty heading, but aria-hidden (not exposed to AT, skipped)

06 — NEUTRAL: empty heading, but display:none (not exposed to AT, skipped)

07 — NEUTRAL: heading has no direct text, but a named descendant (icon-only link with its own aria-label) contributes an accessible name (found on a real site — Navy Federal's logo-link header)

08 — CANTTELL: heading has no direct text, and its only descendant link has no name either (icon-only link with no aria-label)

09 — CANTTELL: heading's only text content is inside a CSS display:none descendant — never exposed to assistive technology, so it must not count as a name (found on a real site — Instacart's footer "Top departments" toggle, a responsive-hidden <button>)

10 — NEUTRAL: heading has no direct text, but a named descendant image (alt text, nested through an extra non-naming <div> wrapper) contributes an accessible name (found on a real site — Party City's logo header)

End of fixture.
